description: This source file defines the user interface components for chat message views within an OpenClaw chat application, including message bubbles, typing indicators, attachment displays, tool call representations, and related styling.

classes.name: ChatBubbleShape
classes.description: Custom shape for chat bubbles with optional tails on left or right sides.

classes.name: ChatMessageBubble
classes.description: Main view for displaying a chat message bubble, including content and styling.

classes.name: ChatMessageBody
classes.description: Internal view managing the message content, attachments, tool calls, and visual styles.

classes.name: AttachmentRow
classes.description: View displaying an individual attachment in the message.

classes.name: ToolCallCard
classes.description: View representing a call to a tool within the chat interface.

classes.name: ToolResultCard
classes.description: View showing the result of a tool execution, with toggle for full output.

classes.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
classes.description: View for displaying a 'typing...' indicator for the assistant.

classes.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
classes.description: View for streaming assistant responses, including ongoing typing indications.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
classes.description: View indicating that tools are currently running, listing pending tool calls.

classes.name: TypingDots
classes.description: Animated view of dots indicating typing activity.

classes.name: ChatAssistantTextBody
classes.description: Displays parsed assistant message content with possible markdown rendering and thinking indicator.

methods.name: inset(by:)
methods.description: Returns a copy of the shape inset by a specified amount.

methods.name: path(in:)
methods.description: Generates the Path for the chat bubble shape with optional tails.

methods.name: strokeBorder(_:lineWidth:)
methods.description: Creates a stroked border around the shape with specified color and line width.
